# `ctx.log`

Writes to the app's log.

```js
ctx.log.debug('cart', ctx.data.cart)
ctx.log.info('order placed')
ctx.log.warn('stock is low')
ctx.log.error('payment failed')
```

`debug` only shows in dev mode (`--dev`) or with `debug: true` in `+config.js`. See [Debugging](https://pocketone.dev/docs/extensions/pages/debugging).
